newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 25 - THURSDAY, MARCH 6.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 25 - THURSDAY, MARCH 6.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-150/95 Portugal v/ Commission: agriculture. Partial annulment of Commission regulation 307/95 of February 14, 1995, fixing final corrected standard amounts for producers of soya beans, rape or colza seed and sunflower seed for the 1994/1995 marketing campaign in that it reduces by 20% the final regional standard amounts for sunflower seeds in Portugal. Violation of Membership Act, of the Blair House Agreement and of Council regulation 1765/92 of June 30, 1992, establishing a support system for producers of certain arable crops, exempting small Portuguese producers from fallow land obligation. Discrimination on the basis of nationality. Exclusion of Portuguese producers from benefits of EU compensation for over production and non-utilisation. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-145/96 van Hoffmann: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9, paragraph 2(e), third clause, of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Services of advisors, engineers, consultancies, lawyers, accountants and similar. Activity of an arbitrator in Paris Chambre de Commerce Internationale.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0815 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-149/94, T-181/94 Kernkraftwerke Lippe-Ems v/ Commission: contracts. Annulment of Commission decision K(94)243 final, of February 4, 1994, on a contract for the provision of natural uranium, submitted by the claimant to the Euratom supply Agency and then deferred to the Commission, in accordance with article 53, paragraph 2 of EAEC treaty.

FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-239/94 EISA v/ Commission: steel. Annulment of Commission decisions 94/256/ECSC, 94/257/ECSC, 94/258/ECSC, 94/259/ECSC, 94/260/ECSC and 94/261/ECSC of April 12, 1994, on aids that Germany, Portugal, Spain and Italy plan to accord to steel companies. Decisions declaring these aids compatible with the Common Market. Conditions on the application of article 95 of ECSC treaty. Misuse of procedure. Misuse of power. Rights of the defence. - Oral procedure T-243/94 British Steel v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision 94/258/ECSC of April 12, 1994 on aid Spain plans to accord to its integrated public steel company Corporacion de la Siderurgia Integral (CSI) and annulment of Commission decision 94/259/ECSC of April 12, 1994, on the granting by Italy of state aid to steel companies in the public sector (Ilva steel group). Possibility of derogating the fifth code concerning state aid to the steel sector by means of EC treaty article 95. Good faith. Proportionality. - Oral procedure T-244/94 Wirtschaftsvereinigung v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision 94/259/ECSC of April 12, 1994, on the granting by Italy of state aid to steel companies in the public sector (Ilva steel group). Possibility of derogating the fifth code concerning state aid to the steel sector by means of EC treaty article 95. Good faith. Non-discrimination.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-59/95 Bastos Moriana: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 77, paragraph 2(b), 78, paragraph 2(b), 79, paragraph 1, and 94, paragraph 5 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Benefits for children under the care of pension holders or to whom pensions are due under the law of several member states and benefits for orphans of a worker subject to the laws of several member states. Right to a supplement when the benefits of the state of residence are less than those provided for by the laws of another state concerned. - Judgment C-177/95 Ebony Maritime: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of decision 93/235/ECSC by representatives of member state governments at the meeting within the Council of April 26, 1993, on trade between the EU and Yugoslavia of coal and steel (Serbia and Montenegro) and of Council regulation 990/93 of April 26, 1993, on trade between the EU and Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro). Vessel seized in international waters carrying goods apparently intended for commercial traffic in Yugoslav territorial waters. - Opinion C-316/95 Generics: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Patent law. National law conferring on the holder of a pharmaceutical patent the right to oppose during the period of the patent the presentation by a third party of specimens to the authorities responsible for the register of drugs. Judicial injunction addressed to a counterfeiter banning marketing, after the expiration of the patent, of products having benefited from the protection of the patent throughout its duration. - Opinion C-349/95 Loendersloot: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 36. Marketing in the EU of alcoholic beverages bearing the trademark of the title-holder who placed it on bottles and packaging. Exercise of the right to trademarks to prevent the removal by a third party of identification marks allowing the trademark holder allowing him to trace breaches in the distribution system and combat parallel imports of his products.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-220/95 Van den Boogaard: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 2, number 1 of the Brussels Convention. Matrimonial arrangements - decision according to which alimony responsibilities between spouses are resolved by the transfer of part of assets. - Opinion joined cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: transport. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 1101/89 of April 27, 1989, on structural improvements to inland navigation and of Commission regulation 1102/89 of April 27, 1989, laying down certain measures on the application of regulation 1101/89 and of regulation 3685/89 of December 8, 1989, amending regulation 1102/89. Break-up premium. Appreciation of usefulness of provisions based on article 75, paragraph 1(c) of EC treaty. - Opinion joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National tax on the exploitation of gaming machines calculated on the amounts staked and where the repercussions imposed by the taxable party on the consumer are not specifically provided for. - Opinion C-63/96 Skripalle: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 27 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National derogation measures aimed at combating fraud and tax evasion. Tax basis in cases of transactions between closely related persons. Rental of real estate. Rent normal, but inferior to costs incurred for the execution of the service. - Oral Procedure C-127/95 Norbrook Laboratoires: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directives 81/851/EEC of September 28, 1981, on the approximation of member states' legislation on veterinary drugs and 81/852/EEC of September 28, 1981, on the approximation of member states' legislation on toxico-pharmacological and clinical analytical norms and protocols in veterinary drug trials. Request for marketing of a veterinary drug. Competence of national authorities. 1Commission $INS3; Line PLL Word too long - story '#247858'.
